The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The oasis of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
